Title: How create new process when parent process already set timer
Description: I know I should set timer when all child process created. 
But, I want to catch `SIGCHLD` signal and create a new child process.
```PHP
Swoole\Process::signal(SIGCHLD, function ($sig) {
    while ($ret = Swoole\Process::wait(false)) {
        // create a new child process
        $p = new Swoole\Process('callback_function');
        $p->start();
    }
});
```
This new child process inherit parent timer ? 
How can I avoid this problem ? 
Clear timer in child process callback function ?
